title: Scout Uniform
subHeader1: The Scout uniform is a way to show that we all belong to the Scouts.
description1: The Scout uniform creates community, strengthens our identity and is part of our symbolic framework. The Scout uniform is used in various designs throughout the world and shows that we belong to a global movement.
description2: In Sweden, the scout uniform consists of three garments: a t-shirt, a polo shirt and a shirt. Badges are attached to the shirt that tell us what we have done, what interests we have and our belongings.
description3: In the Scout Shop there are different types of scout clothing, where you can read more about them, how they are used and why we have them.
